عربوں کے ہاں جو اونٹنی اپنی افادیت کھو دیتی، کسی کام کی نہ رہتی، اُسے پالنے کا خرچہ ، اُس سے حاصل ہونے والے فائدے سے کہیں زیادہ ہو جاتا، تو اُسے ریوڑ سے الگ کر کے جنگل کی طرف چھوڑ آتے ، جہاں وہ کھلے میدانوں میں آوارہ پھرتی، جہاں سے چاہتی کھاتی پیتی اور جہاں چاہتی لیٹ جاتی۔ یہ اونٹنی اتنی بے وقعت ہو جاتی کہ اس کی فکر کرنا بھی بے معنی لگتا، بلکہ اس کی ملکیت کا دعوی کرنے والا بھی کوئی نہ ہوتا۔ یہ اونٹنی اپنے بھاری بھرکم جسم کے ساتھ ، زمین کے کچھ حصے پر جگہ تو گھیرتی، آکسیجن بھی استعمال کرتی ، لیکن اپنے وجود کے مقصد میں کوئی حصہ ادا نہ کر پاتی ، نہ دودھ دیتی ، نہ بچے ، نہ اس کی کھال استعمال ہوتی اور نہ گوشت۔ اس اونٹنی کو سُدی کہا جاتا ۔ اَیَحْسَبُ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنْ یُّتْرَكَ سُدًى(36) کیا انسان یہ سمجھتا ہے کہ اسے یونہی آزاد چھوڑ دیا جائے گا۔ (سورت قیامہ: 36) قرآن کریم نے اس لفظ کو ایسے انسان کےلیے استعمال کیا ہے جو اپنی اصل ذمہ داری اور مقصد کو چھوڑ بیٹھا ہو، جس کی زندگی وحی کے نور سے خالی ہو ، جس کے ذہن میں موت کی کوئی فکر نہ ہو، جسے آخرت میں جوابدہی کا کوئی احساس نہ ہو، جو صرف کھاتا پیتا، جاب اور ملازمت کرتا ہو، جس کا سب سے بڑا مقصد گھر بنانا، دوسرے ملک شفٹ ہونا، سوشل میڈیا استعمال کرنا، اس پر فالورز کا ڈھیر لگانا، کسی خوبصورت لڑکی یا لڑکے سے شادی کرنا، ڈگری حاصل کرنا اور کسی بڑے عہدے پر براجمان ہونا ہو۔ اس سے زیادہ زندگی کا کوئی مقصد نہ ذہن میں ہو، نہ عمل میں۔ یہ شخص سُدی ہے۔ کیونکہ اس نے اپنی تخلیق کا مقصد چھوڑ دیا ہے، اب یہ دنیا کے کسی بھی شعبے میں کامیابیوں کے جھنڈے گاڑ دے، سورج کی شعاعوں کو گرفتار کر لے، ستاروں کی گزرگاہوں کو جان لے، سمندروں کے سینے چاک کر ڈالے، زمین کے پوشیدہ خزانوں پر قبضہ کر لے، روشنی کی رفتار پر کمند ڈال دے، مصروفیت کے ہزاروں ڈھونگ رچا لے۔ تب بھی یہ سُدی ہی ہے۔ یہ ایسا جانور ہے جو زمین پر بوجھ ہے، اس کے مرنے پر نہ زمین روتی ہے، نہ آسمان۔ فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالْاَرْضُ پھر نہ ان پر آسمان رویا، نہ زمین۔ (سورت دخان: 29) جن مقاصد اور اہداف کو وہ اپنی زندگی میں جی رہا ہے، اس کے بقول یہی زندگی کے حقیقی مقاصد ہیں، لیکن حقیقت میں یہ مقاصد معاشرے نے اس پر مسلط کیے ہیں، کامیابی و ناکامی کے یہ معیارات زمانے نے رائج کیے ہیں، اگر وہ قرآن پڑھ لے، نبی اکرم ﷺ کی سیرت کو دیکھ لے، تو اسے شدت سے احساس ہو کہ میں تو سُدی ہوں۔ جب تک اس کا دل نورِ قرآن سے منور نہیں ہو جاتا، یہ مادی کامیابیاں اسے اصل مقصدِ زندگی تک پہنچنے ہی نہیں دیں گی۔ یہ قرآن ہی ہے جو دنیا میں مصروف رکھ کر بھی آخرت کو نظروں سے پوشیدہ نہیں ہونے دیتا : وَ ابْتَغِ فِیْمَاۤ اٰتٰىكَ اللّٰهُ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَ لَا تَنْسَ نَصِیْبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا اور اللہ نے تمہیں جو کچھ دے رکھا ہے، اس کے ذریعے آخرت والا گھر بنانے کی کوشش کرو اور دنیا میں سے بھی اپنے حصے کو نظر انداز نہ کرو۔ (سورت قصص: 77) ابھی سانس آ رہی ہے، تو موقع ہے، سوچ لیں کہ سُدی بن کر زندگی گزارنی ہے یا اپنی مقصدیت اور نافعیت ثابت کرنی ہے؟ اگر با مقصد اور نافع بننا چاہتے ہیں، تو آج ہی سے قرآن کریم کے ساتھ جڑ جائیں۔ یہ آپ کے ہر لمحے اور ہر قدم میں مقصدیت کو کوٹ کوٹ کر بھر دے گا۔ محمد اکبر پیکر شاپور زدران، ستاره‌ی پیشین تیم ملی کریکت افغانستان، پس از چاشت ام‌روز (چهارشنبه، ۱۷ سرطان) از هند به کابل منتقل شد. شاپور زدران، یکی از چهره‌های برجسته و تأثیرگذار کریکت افغانستان، شام سه‌شنبه پس از چندین ماه مبارزه با بیماری، در یکی از شفاخانه‌های شهر دهلی‌نو هند چشم از جهان فرو بست. او از ماه جنوری سال روان برای درمان بیماری نادر سیستم ایمنی بدن (HLH) در هند بستری بود، اما تلاش پزشکان برای نجات جانش نتیجه نداد. منبع‌های نزدیک به خانواده‌ی زدران گفته‌اند که پیکر این ورزش‌کار پیشین پس از کابل، برای برگزاری مراسم تشییع و خاک‌سپاری به زادگاهش منتقل می‌شود. انتظار می‌رود در این مراسم، عضوهای خانواده، شماری از مقام‌های حکومتی، مسئولان کریکت، ورزش‌کاران و صدها تن از هواداران او حضور داشته باشند. شاپور زدران از پیش‌گامان کریکت افغانستان به شمار می‌رفت و نقش برجسته‌ای در رشد و جهانی‌شدن این رشته ورزشی در کشور داشت. او بین سال‌های ۲۰۰۹ تا ۲۰۲۰ در ۴۴ مسابقه یک‌روزه و ۳۶ دیدار بیست‌آوره برای تیم ملی افغانستان به میدان رفت و با عمل‌کرد درخشان خود، در صعود تیم ملی به رقابت‌های معتبر جهانی، از جمله جام جهانی کریکت، سهم مهمی ایفا کرد. درگذشت شاپور زدران با موج گسترده‌ای از پیام‌های تسلیت از سوی بازی‌کنان، مسئولان کریکت افغانستان و هواداران این ورزش همراه شده‌است. بسیاری از آنان از او به‌عنوان یکی از معماران نسل طلایی کریکت افغانستان یاد کرده و خدماتش به ورزش کشور را ماندگار توصیف کرده‌اند. #خبریک Video

One fan – a wheelchair user – can be seen in the middle of a circle of dancing fans. They surrounded him and lifted him into the air as the group celebrated. The wheelchair user pumped his arms and grinned from ear to ear. The crowd continued hyping the man up after his wheelchair was placed back on the ground. France is slated to play Morocco in the quarterfinals on July 9. Video

İki günlük yoğun Ankara Zirvesi, Türkiye’nin NATO’nun güvenlik gündemine yön veren, krizlerde diyalog kanallarını açık tutan, bölgesel barış perspektifini koruyan ve savunma sanayisi kapasitesiyle İttifakın dönüşümüne somut katkı sağlayan merkezî bir aktör olduğunu göstermiştir. Türkiye olarak müttefiklerimizle iş birliğimizi güçlendirmeye, küresel barış ve güvenliğe katkı sunmaya kararlılıkla devam edeceğiz.

Zirve’de aldığımız kararlarla NATO’nun caydırıcılık ve savunma kapasitesini güçlendirme, transatlantik bağı tahkim etme ve İttifakın geleceğini daha güçlü bir Avrupa, daha güçlü bir NATO anlayışı temelinde inşa etme irademizi bir kez daha ortaya koyduk. Ankara Zirvesi Sonuç Bildirisi’nde Washington Antlaşması’nın 5’inci maddesine ve kolektif savunma ilkesine olan sarsılmaz bağlılığımızı teyit ettik. Bildiride ayrıca müttefikler arasındaki savunma ticareti engellerinin kaldırılması, 50 milyar doları aşan yeni savunma tedarik anlaşmaları, Ukrayna’ya askerî teçhizat, yardım ve eğitim desteği sağlanması gibi konuların yanı sıra savunma sanayisi kapasitesinin artırılması; yapay zekâ, siber güvenlik, uzay, entegre hava ve füze savunması, insansız sistemler ve derin hassas vuruş kabiliyetleri gibi alanlarda İttifakın daha güçlü ve hazırlıklı hale getirilmesi de Zirve’nin öncelikli başlıkları arasında yer aldı. Türkiye olarak biz de sahip olduğumuz tecrübe, askerî kabiliyet ve gelişen savunma sanayisi altyapımızla bu sürece en güçlü katkıyı sunmaya devam edeceğiz. Türkiye, yalnızca ev sahibi ülke değil, İttifakın savunma, diplomasi ve kriz çözme kapasitesine doğrudan katkı sunan kilit bir müttefiktir. Savunma harcamalarımızı 2030’dan önce %3,5 seviyesine çıkarma irademizi ortaya koyduk. Güvenlik ve dayanıklılıkla bağlantılı harcamalarda ise hâlihazırda %1,5’lik bütçe payına ulaşmış durumdayız. Çelik Kubbe Projesi için hava ve füze savunma kabiliyetlerine 24 milyar dolar ilave bütçe ayırdığımızı da ifade ettik. Bu vesileyle ayrıca belirtmek gerekir ki Türkiye, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşında barış için iletişim kanallarını açık tutarken; İran-ABD sürecinde itidal, diplomasi ve kalıcı barışı; Gazze, Lübnan ve Libya başlıklarında da ateşkes, istikrar ve çok taraflı iş birliği yaklaşımını savunmaya devam etmektedir.

Küresel güvenlik mimarisinin büyük güç rekabeti, hibrit tehditler, bölgesel krizler ve yeni teknolojilerle yeniden şekillendiği bir dönemde icra edilen bu Zirve, ülkemizin küresel güvenlik mimarisindeki merkezî rolünü, diplomasi kapasitesini ve müttefiklik sorumluluğunu bir kez daha ortaya koymuştur. “NATO 3.0” vizyonu, Avrupa’nın savunma kapasitesini güçlendirmeyi ve İttifakın yeni döneme daha hazırlıklı biçimde uyum sağlamasını hedeflemektedir. Türkiye ise sahip olduğu askerî kabiliyet, stratejik konum, diplomatik birikim ve savunma sanayisi kapasitesiyle bu dönüşümün tam merkezinde NATO’nun en güçlü aktörlerinden biri olarak yer almaktadır. Savunma Sanayisi Forumu ile başlayan Zirve’de ortak üretim, tedarik zincirlerinin güçlendirilmesi, savunma teknolojilerinde eş güdüm ve müttefikler arası iş birliği imkânları ele alınmıştır. Zirve marjında NATO Genel Sekreteri Mark Rutte, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Kanada Başbakanı Mark Carney, Finlandiya Cumhurbaşkanı Alexander Stubb, Birleşik Krallık Başbakanı Keir Starmer, Almanya Şansölyesi Friedrich Merz, İtalya Başbakanı Giorgia Meloni, Fransa Cumhurbaşkanı Emmanuel Macron, Bulgaristan Başbakanı Rumen Radev, Suriye Cumhurbaşkanı Ahmed Şara, AB Konseyi Başkanı Antonio Costa, AB Komisyonu Başkanı Ursula von der Leyen, Karadağ Başbakanı Milojko Spajic, Slovakya Cumhurbaşkanı Peter Pellegrini ve Arnavutluk Başbakanı Edi Rama ile ikili görüşmeler gerçekleştirdik. Bu temaslarda ikili ilişkiler, AB ile münasebetler, savunma sanayisi, ticaret, enerji, güvenlik, Avrupa-Atlantik güvenliği, Balkan Barış Platformu, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşı, İran-ABD süreci, Gazze, Libya, Suriye ve bölgesel istikrar başlıkları başta olmak üzere birçok kritik konu ele alınmıştır. Zirve marjında ayrıca Birleşik Krallık ile Güvenlik ve Savunma Ortaklığı Anlaşması imzalanmış, Kanada ile Serbest Ticaret Anlaşması müzakereleri de başlatılmıştır. Özellikle Zirve vesilesiyle ülkemize resmî ziyaret gerçekleştiren kıymetli dostum ABD Başkanı Sayın Trump ile gerçekleştirdiğimiz yapıcı ve verimli görüşmelerin, millî muharip uçağımız KAAN ve F-35 programı başta olmak üzere savunma sanayisi alanında ülkemizin beklentilerine uygun somut neticelere vesile olacağına inanıyorum.

Dumbacher. “The global leadership role that the United States played starting after World War II is no more,” she writes. “If the United States really wants to make the most of its military in a world of great power rivalry, it will need to win back the trust it has lost among allies and partners by resuming diplomacy, investing in development, and avoiding overstretch.” “Future defense policy should build on the United States’ military strengths: its versatile defense platforms and munitions, its professional military personnel, and its world-leading innovation,” she writes. “The U.S. military cannot prepare to defeat its main rivals while stretching thin to fight in Greenland, the Americas, or the Middle East.” “But defense policy can only go so far. If the United States really wants to make the most of its military in a world of great power rivalry, it will need to win back the trust it has lost among allies and partners by resuming diplomacy, investing in development, and avoiding overstretch,” Dumbacher writes.

Try @Grok 4.5! Artificial Analysis (@ArtificialAnlys) Grok 4.5 is the top non-Anthropic model on AA-Briefcase, combining frontier agentic knowledge work capabilities with leading cost and time-efficiency Yesterday @SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5, a new frontier-level model with strengths in agentic coding and knowledge work. On AA-Briefcase, Grok 4.5 scores 1328, a +578 improvement over Grok 4.3 and the highest score of any non-Anthropic model (note that GPT-5.6 not released yet). It achieves this while sitting on the cost and time efficiency frontier, averaging $1.12 per task, 86% lower than Claude Opus 4.8 (max), and 12.4 minutes per task, around half the time of Opus 4.8 (max). AA-Briefcase is our new proprietary benchmark for agentic knowledge work, testing models on a fully private dataset of realistic tasks across thousands of complex input files. Tasks require deliverables like spreadsheets, presentations, and UI mock-ups, with performance combined into a single AA-Briefcase Elo across correctness, analytical quality, and presentation quality. Key results for Grok 4.5 with high reasoning on AA-Briefcase: ➤ Frontier agentic knowledge work capabilities: Grok 4.5 achieves an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1328, the highest score of any non-Anthropic model, behind only Claude Fable 5 (1390), Claude Sonnet 5 (max, 1390), and Claude Opus 4.8 (max, 1354). Across the three AA-Briefcase scoring axes, Grok 4.5 is strongest on objective rubric criteria and analytical quality, with comparatively weaker presentation quality. It achieves the second-highest overall rubric pass rate (40.7%), behind Claude Fable 5 (56%) and Claude Sonnet 5 (42.3%) ➤ Leading cost efficiency: Grok 4.5 averages a cost of $1.12 per AA-Briefcase task, placing it on the cost-performance Pareto frontier. This is much most cost effective than peer models such as Claude Opus 4.8 (max, $8.26) and GLM 5.2 (max, $1.71) ➤ Faster task completion: Grok 4.5 averages 12.4 minutes per AA-Briefcase task, also placing it on the speed-performance frontier. It is much faster than Claude Opus 4.8 (max, 23.9 min) and Claude Sonnet 5 (max, 36.9 min), primarily due to lower turn use. Grok 4.5 averages just 23 turns per task, ~40% of GLM 5.2 (max, 56) and ~13% of Claude Sonnet 5 (max, 183) Congratulations to @SpaceXAI, @cursor_ai, and @elonmusk on the impressive release! — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ArtificialAnlys/status/2075264155527901522#m

প্রেস বিজ্ঞপ্তি পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে বন্যা ও পাহাড়ধস মোকাবিলায় বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর উদ্ধার, ত্রাণ সহায়তা ও যোগাযোগ পুনরুদ্ধার কার্যক্রম অব্যাহত ঢাকা, ০৯ জুলাই ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে চলমান ভারী বর্ষণ, পাহাড়ি ঢল ও পাহাড়ধসের ফলে সৃষ্ট দুর্যোগ মোকাবিলায় বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী স্থানীয় প্রশাসন, অন্যান্য নিরাপত্তা বাহিনী এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট সরকারি সংস্থাসমূহের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে উদ্ধার, ত্রাণ সহায়তা, নিরাপদ স্থানে স্থানান্তর এবং যোগাযোগ ব্যবস্থা পুনরুদ্ধারে নিরলসভাবে কাজ করে যাচ্ছে। দুর্যোগের কারণে পার্বত্য অঞ্চলের বিভিন্ন স্থানে পাহাড়ধস ও জলাবদ্ধতার ফলে সড়ক যোগাযোগ বিঘ্নিত হলে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর সদস্যরা প্রয়োজনীয় প্রকৌশল সরঞ্জাম ও ভারী যন্ত্রপাতির সহায়তায় মাটি ও ধ্বংসাবশেষ অপসারণ করে যোগাযোগ ব্যবস্থা পুনঃস্থাপনে কাজ করছেন। একই সঙ্গে ভূমিধসের উচ্চ ঝুঁকিতে থাকা এলাকা থেকে প্রায় ২২১ টি পরিবারকে নিরাপদ আশ্রয়ে স্থানান্তর করা হয়েছে। এছাড়াও, দুর্গম এলাকায় আটকে পড়া পর্যটকদের নিরাপদে উদ্ধারে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করেছে। এ পর্যন্ত বান্দরবান থেকে ১৪০ জন এবং সাজেকে আটকে পড়া প্রায় ৬০০ জন পর্যটকের মধ্যে প্রথম ধাপে ১৫০ জনকে স্থানীয় প্রশাসনের সহায়তায় নিরাপদ স্থানে সরিয়ে নেওয়া হয়েছে। অবশিষ্ট পর্যটকদের পর্যায়ক্রমে নিরাপদ স্থানে স্থানান্তরের কার্যক্রম চলমান রয়েছে। দুর্যোগে ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত মানুষের দুর্ভোগ লাঘবে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী বিভিন্ন এলাকায় রান্না করা খাবার, শুকনো খাবার, বিশুদ্ধ পানি এবং অন্যান্য জরুরি ত্রাণসামগ্রী বিতরণ করছে। পাশাপাশি ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত পাহাড়ি ও বাঙালি পরিবারের মাঝে চাল, ডাল, তেল, আলুসহ প্রয়োজনীয় খাদ্যসামগ্রী বিতরণ অব্যাহত রয়েছে। বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী সার্বিক পরিস্থিতি নিবিড়ভাবে পর্যবেক্ষণ করছে এবং স্থানীয় প্রশাসন ও সংশ্লিষ্ট সংস্থার সঙ্গে সমন্বয়ের মাধ্যমে প্রয়োজনীয় উদ্ধার, ত্রাণ সহায়তা, যোগাযোগ পুনঃস্থাপন ও পুনর্বাসন কার্যক্রম অব্যাহত রাখবে। বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী সর্বদা দেশের যেকোনো দুর্যোগ ও জাতীয় সংকটে জনগণের জীবন, সম্পদ ও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবকাঠামো সুরক্ষায় সর্বোচ্চ পেশাদারিত্ব, নিষ্ঠা ও দায়িত্ববোধের সঙ্গে দায়িত্ব পালন করে আসছে এবং ভবিষ্যতেও এ ধারা অব্যাহত থাকবে।

Disheartened Paraguayans burned a Kylian Mbappe effigy during the annual San Juan Ara festival on July 4, just hours after France eliminated La Albirroja from the World Cup in the round of 16. Footage from Steven Pegelow, who told Storyful he was visiting Paraguay during the tournament, shows a man wearing his national team’s jersey lighting up a large, hung doll with the name “Mbappe” written across its chest. The custom is part of the Judas Kai tradition, which sees the mannequin of an “unpopular” personality being scorched during the festival each year. “In the past, the figure you burned was Judas (for betraying Jesus). Today, you burn an unpopular figure,” Pegelow said. “Since the France vs Paraguay game just happened, the figure they burned was Mbappe,” who rejected the Paraguayan goalkeeper’s handshake at the end of the game. The match drew criticism from numerous sports personalities and supporters, culminating in Paraguayan Senator Celeste Amarilla’s “despicable” and “racist” comments aimed at the French top scorer. The Paraguayan government and the United Nations condemned the comments, and the French Football Federation announced it would file a lawsuit against the politician. Video

40 out of 86 Brown students scored a perfect 100 on their midterm. Then the professor moved the final in person, and 22 of those perfect scorers never showed up again. He'd suspected AI cheating from the start. The take-home midterm was deliberately harder than usual, yet the class averaged 96 when the historical range is 65 to 80. Some answers contained odd phrasing that matched what ChatGPT produced when he ran the questions through it himself. Roberto Serrano has taught economics at Brown for 34 years. He filed no accusations. He announced the final would be in person, count for half the grade, and that if the two distributions didn't match, the final alone would determine grades. Then the exodus. 27 students never showed up. 22 of them had perfect midterms. Of the 59 who did show, 19 failed. Several signed the exam and turned it in blank. The average fell from 96 to 48, the lowest in the course's history. He never needed a plagiarism detector. The cheaters identified themselves by walking away. A grade distribution became a confession. Here's the part nobody's sitting with. Serrano proved it. He sent the distributions to Brown's dean and provost. The provost never responded. The academic committee's reply amounted to calling it "a wake-up call." The students who bailed before the final walked away clean. Every university in America is now grading two populations, students and students plus ChatGPT, on one curve. The honest kids in Serrano's class watched a 96 average get set by machines, then sat a real final against it. The cheaters lost nothing. That's the incentive structure now, and it grades itself. Kostyantynivka Update In recent weeks, Russian vanguard elements have advanced into significant portions of Kostyantynivka. On July 3, the Russian Ministry of Defense claimed the complete capture of the settlement, marking the intended culmination of its offensive. However, independent analysis of available evidence casts significant doubt on this assertion. Recent visual evidence published by the Russian 4th Guards Motorized Rifle Brigade and the 3rd Army Corps shows Russian personnel displaying flags at various locations across the town. While analysis suggests these images are authentic and confirm a genuine Russian physical presence, they do not substantiate absolute territorial control. The footage predominantly consists of isolated, fleeting snapshots of individual soldiers or small two-man teams, rather than consolidated unit formations. (Red markers denote these verified Russian positions on the accompanying map) The primary vector of the Russian advance into the western high-rise residential districts originated from Illinivka. Russian information operations have attributed this breach to an alleged tactical failure by elements of the Ukrainian 156th Mechanized Brigade deployed in this sector. Consequently, Russian forward elements have dispersed across much of the western side of the town, with sightings reported throughout the area west of the Kryvyi Torets river. Despite this, isolated visual evidence confirms a sustained Ukrainian presence. Given the highly fluid nature of the combat environment, clearly delineating consolidated Russian control zones from Ukrainian defensive positions remains challenging. As a result, we currently classify the entire western sector as contested pending more definitive data. This sector is fragmented, featuring localized zones of exclusive Russian control alongside areas where Ukrainian forces still maintain a tactical advantage. East of the Kryvyi Torets river, Russian forces have entered the urban periphery—primarily advancing through the forested terrain near Novodmytrivka—but geolocation data indicates they have not yet penetrated the deeper urban center. Notably, the eastern high-density residential estates appear to remain firmly under Ukrainian control. Recent footage from the Ukrainian 19th Army Corps, corroborates this by inadvertently showing Ukrainian personnel actively operating at various coordinates within the city limits. While scattered images of Russian flag-bearers suggest isolated river crossings from west to east, we assess that the settlement remains functionally bisected, with minimal cross-river force projection by either side. (Verified Ukrainian positions from recent days are marked in blue) Furthermore, there has been a marked increase in documented Ukrainian airstrikes targeting Russian positions within the urban perimeter. While this surge in visual evidence may partially stem from revised operational security guidelines regarding media publication, it strongly implies that the Ukrainian Air Force places a high strategic priority on this sector. (Orange markers on the map indicate these airstrike locations) Ongoing Russian disinformation campaigns have increasingly mischaracterized combat footage. For example, we have identified numerous videos falsely labeled as Ukrainian forces being shelled in areas north of Kostyantynivka; however, geolocation confirms these strikes are actually occurring within the city limits of Kostyantynivka itself. Additionally, collaborative research with @WarUnitObserver indicates that the Ukrainian Armed Forces have deployed elements from three distinct assault regiments over recent weeks to conduct clearing and stabilization operations within the city. Because visual confirmation of their tactical impact is currently unavailable in open sources, their specific unit designations are being withheld in accordance with OPSEC. A notable anomaly is the current absence of footage depicting Ukrainian armored vehicles and Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) operating within the city limits. This suppression is likely tied to the intense concentration of Russian fiber-optic drones, which currently significantly restrict the mobility of these vehicles. Conversely, there is also a lack of visual evidence of Russian use of UGVs, motorcycles, or armored vehicles in the city, which suggests that they largely reach the city on foot. Extending from the Kostyantynivka valley, the contested zone appears to have expanded. We have documented multiple individual Russian infiltrations into Dovha Balka and at least one recorded incursion into Rozkishne. However, a sustained Ukrainian presence remains visually evident in both locations, as well as in Stepanivka to the south: a tactical reality consistently omitted by Russian information operations. Meanwhile, the frontline around Chasiv Yar and its immediate environs appears to remain relatively stable. In contrast, the settlements of Novodmytrivka and Molocharka, situated on Kostyantynivka's eastern flank, are currently the site of intense combat engagements due to pressure from the Russian 136th Separate Guards Motorized Rifle Brigade. As there is less video footage available from both flanks of the city, it's harder to assess the situation there. In summary, the tactical situation in Kostyantynivka has deteriorated significantly for Ukrainian forces over the past few weeks. Nevertheless, substantial portions of the settlement remain either contested or under consolidated Ukrainian control, and Russian forces have yet to establish comprehensive territorial dominance. Consequently, the Russian Ministry of Defense's declaration regarding the complete capture of the town is assessed as highly premature. The trajectory of this engagement will depend heavily on the efficacy of recent Ukrainian tactical deployments and counter-maneuvers. We will continue to monitor and update this operational assessment. Map reference: map.ukrdailyupdate.com/ Report by @AudaxonX

Aaron Burnett (@aaronburnett) Grok 4.5 is looking like a success with help from Cursor data but underneath the surface we expect future Grok/Cursor model training is likely to speed up in the coming months. We've spent several months getting up to speed on the SpaceXAI business, especially the tech underneath it. The C rewrite was under appreciated by the investor community so we dug in to quantify its impact. including building a physics first model that functions as a stopwatch for the SpaceXAI model factory. Bottomline: C-rewrite gets SpaceXAI faster model cycles, leveraging 33% more tokens/second/GPU against SOTA competition resulting in the potential to shipping new models every ~3.5 weeks. two core learnings from this modeling exercise: 1: the training cycle speed up is primarily coming from RL (not pretraining) where the increased tokens/second/GPU advantage can shave up 2+ weeks off full model training cycle. 2: the rewrite itself should compound the time savings as model sizes grow. at ~2T shaving off 2-3 weeks, ~8 weeks at 6T, and 15 weeks at 10T. Note: a 20T parameter model likely runs into a data bottleneck prior to a training speed bottleneck but the directional advantage stands. Also we assume tokens/second/gpu advantage will melt over time as competitors try to match it. when you do the math, in true SpaceX and Elon fashion, it looks like they are attempting to build a SOTA model factory that can pump out bigger models faster than anyone else. ज्ञानराधा मल्टीस्टेटच्या ठेवीदारांचे पैसे परत मिळवून देण्यासाठी राज्य सरकारची कार्यवाही वेगवान मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज विधान भवन, मुंबई येथे 'ज्ञानराधा मल्टीस्टेट को-ऑप. क्रेडिट सोसायटी, बीड'च्या सभासद व ठेवीदारांसंदर्भात बैठक पार पडली. बीड येथील ज्ञानराधा मल्टीस्टेट को. ऑपरेटिव्ह सोसायटीमधील ठेवीदारांना त्यांचे कष्टाचे पैसे तातडीने परत मिळवून देण्याच्या कार्यवाहीला गती द्यावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, ठेवीदारांचे हित जपण्यासाठी महाराष्ट्र गुंतवणूकदार हितसंरक्षण (एमपीआयडी) कायद्यात आवश्यक सुधारणा करण्यासंदर्भात प्रस्ताव सादर करावा. हा कायदा अधिक सक्षम करून त्याअंतर्गत वित्तीय संस्था किंवा बँकांच्या मालमत्ता जप्त करणे आणि त्यांचा लिलाव करणे, ही प्रक्रिया जलद करावी. सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या कायद्यानुसार क्लिष्ट आणि दीर्घकालीन प्रक्रियेला यंत्रणांना सामोरे जावे लागते. या प्रक्रियेत बदल करून, केंद्र शासनाच्या अंमलबजावणी संचालनालयाच्या धर्तीवर अशा प्रकरणांतील जप्तीच्या कार्यवाहीसाठी राज्यातही व्यवस्था तयार करावी. यामुळे मालमत्ता जप्ती आणि लिलावाची कारवाई जलद गतीने करणे शक्य होईल. बँकेच्या किंवा संस्थेच्या सर्व मालमत्तांचे अचूक मूल्यांकन करून, ज्या मालमत्तांचे मूल्यांकन सर्वाधिक आहे, त्यांची प्राधान्याने विक्री केली जावी. मूल्यांकनानुसारच मालमत्तांची विक्री करून पारदर्शक पद्धतीने हा निधी थेट गुंतवणूकदारांना दिला जावा. या संपूर्ण प्रकरणाचा तिढा तातडीने सुटण्यासाठी गृह विभागाने अंमलबजावणी संचालनालयासोबत (ईडी) एकत्र बैठक घ्यावी आणि या कायदेशीर व तांत्रिक बाबींवर तातडीने कोणती पावले उचलता येतील, याबाबतची ठोस कार्यपद्धती निश्चित करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. यावेळी मंत्री बाबासाहेब पाटील, राज्यमंत्री डॉ. पंकज भोयर, राज्यमंत्री योगेश कदम, आमदार सुरेश धस, आमदार प्रकाश सोळंके, आमदार विजयसिंह पंडित व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @babasahebpati1 @DRPANKAJBHOYAR @iYogeshRKadam @SureshDhasBJP @VijaysinhPandit #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Dnyanradha

विमानतळ फनेल झोन व मिलिटरी ट्रान्समीटर स्टेशन निर्बंधग्रस्त इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासाला गती मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज विधान भवन, मुंबई येथे विमानतळ फनेल झोन तसेच जुहू येथील मिलिटरी ट्रान्समीटर स्टेशनच्या निर्बंधांमुळे बाधित इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासासंदर्भात बैठक पार पडली. छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज आंतरराष्ट्रीय विमानतळाच्या फनेल झोनमधील जुन्या इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासाला प्रोत्साहन देण्यासाठी महत्त्वाचे बदल करण्यात आले आहेत. या फनेल झोनमध्ये सांताक्रूझ, विले पार्ले आणि कुर्ला येथील इमारतींचा समावेश आहे. या इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासाला संबंधित यंत्रणांनी गती द्यावी. तसेच जुहू येथील मिलिटरी ट्रान्समीटर स्टेशनच्या निर्बंधांमुळे बाधित इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासाच्या कार्यवाहीला वेग द्यावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. फनेल क्षेत्रातील निर्बंधांमुळे बाधित इमारतींच्या संदर्भात चटई निर्देशांकाचे (एफएसआय) 'पोटेन्शिअल' कुठे द्यायचे याबाबत महापालिकेने निर्णय घ्यावा. देण्यात येणारा चटई निर्देशांक कुठे वापरायचा आहे, याबाबतही ठरवावे. रस्ता रुंदीकरणाप्रमाणे उच्च चटई निर्देशांक लगतच्या किंवा जवळील बांधकामात एकत्र करता येईल का, याबाबत पडताळणी करावी. बाधित इमारतींच्या पुनर्विकासासाठी रस्त्याच्या रुंदीनुसार उच्चस्तरीय 'पोटेन्शिअल' असणारा चटई निर्देशांक देण्यात यावा, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुंबई शहरामध्ये झोपडपट्टी पुनर्विकास प्राधिकरण, म्हाडा, सिडको अशा विविध यंत्रणांच्या माध्यमातून गृहनिर्माणाची कामे होत असतात. या On the evening of July 8, a crowd in Lviv overturned a military vehicle and attacked servicemembers from a Territorial Recruitment Centre conducting routine notification duties. The incident was filmed and spread across social media. It requires honest explanation for international audiences — because it is both genuinely disturbing and genuinely complex. What happened: TRC soldiers stopped a 30-year-old man — born 1996, of mobilisation age — who had been violating military registration rules since June 12. After he was taken to the TRC, a second group of soldiers remained at the scene. A crowd surrounded them, became aggressive, damaged their vehicle, and eventually overturned it. Why it matters: Ukraine is in the fifth year of a full-scale war. Mobilisation is a contested, painful issue in a society where hundreds of thousands are already serving — many since 2022, without a defined end date until the June reform. Tension between civilians and recruitment structures is real. But it is also exploited by Russia — actively and deliberately. "If today you tear off the uniform and beat a soldier of your own army — think about who will defend you tomorrow from an enemy army that will do the same to you." — General Kyrylo Budanov, Head of the Office of the President "There is no justification for this. The people who are grateful to you for your service — who know what price you and your families pay — are incomparably more. And we are with you." — Military Ombudsman Olha Reshetylova The Ministry of Defence @DefenceU statement was direct: "Attacks on servicemembers are unacceptable. Everyone is equal before the law. Responsibility must follow in every case of violence and aggression. The only one who benefits from situations like this is the enemy. The language of hatred toward your own army will lead to irreparable consequences." The MoD also acknowledged the structural problem: "Mobilisation is a necessary component of Ukraine's defence. Its methods require improvement and that process is ongoing. We expect law enforcement to properly assess the situation in Lviv. Those responsible must be identified and held accountable." Olha Reshetylova named the root cause: mobilisation reform must begin with a complete review of deferment principles. Many TRC soldiers are combat veterans transferred to recruitment roles after being wounded at the front. Attacking them is not a protest against a policy — it is violence against people who have already paid a higher price than most. Head of Lviv state administration Kozytsky ordered immediate identification and prosecution of all involved. The TRC confirmed the man stopped was 30 years old and had been violating registration rules — not a random civilian. But one thing is not complex: Attacking your own soldiers while they are at war is not protest. It is a gift to the enemy that started the war — and Russia is already amplifying every frame of this footage across its information networks. Ukraine's defenders on the front line are watching these videos too. "The enemy is Russia. Remember who we are actually fighting." We started this journey with a clear commitment: to bring this violence out of the shadows and place it firmly where it belongs, at the centre of the public health agenda. For many survivors, three words can change everything: I believe you. But those words must be matched by action: by health workers trained to respond with compassion; by services that protect dignity and safety; by leaders willing to speak out; and by prevention efforts that stop violence before it happens. My sincere thanks to the countries, health professionals, partners, advocates, survivors and WHO/Europe colleagues who have helped turn this commitment into action. VIDEO | Scottish actor-writer Richard Gadd says he's drawn to characters who are "complicated" rather than simply good or evil. Whether it is stalkers or violent offenders, Gadd believes trauma, mental illness and human contradictions deserve a more nuanced portrayal on screen. "I just suppose I see human life in that way. I see us all as this sort of combination of good and bad, odd idiosyncrasies, and all kinds of different contradictions, really. I think the human makeup is so complicated that all I try to do in bringing my work to the screen is show how complicated it is. I think we've seen the version of the stalker show before where the stalker has absolutely no morality whatsoever, and they just follow a really good family man or family woman around, making their life miserable. I thought we'd seen that before. To be honest, we had seen that before. In fact, stalking is a mental illness. People who engage in stalking have personality disorders and all kinds of problems. I thought that was something I hadn't seen before. I've also seen a lot of violent people on TV before, but the justification for the violence is simply that they're violent, they're sociopathic, or they're psychopathic. But I think a lot of people in life who commit violence do so because it comes from trauma. It comes from difficult experiences. That was something I wanted to bring to the screen. I always try to lean into the humanity and the complications of character because I think that's sometimes what's missing on screen these days." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

VIDEO | After the global success of Baby Reindeer, Richard Gadd returns with "Half Man", a new six-episode drama now streaming on Lionsgate Play. In an interview with PTI, the Scottish actor-writer says the concept first came to him years ago during a ride on the London Underground. "For me, every creative idea -- the nugget of something -- starts with the impulse that it's interesting enough to follow through on and commit my life to. I feel like if you can't get an idea out of your head, then you should follow it. I remember I was on the Tube, the London Underground, and I came up with the idea where you've got these two men in a barn having a weird conversation. One of them is way more masculine than the other, at least stereotypically speaking, and he punches him, and then there is a flashback. I got that kind of gust of wind, or creative impulse. I got off the Tube and typed the scene onto my phone. I wrote it out, and the scene remained kind of what it was. From that point on, I couldn't get it out of my head, really. All the way through "Baby Reindeer", I was thinking about it and thinking, 'What if he did this? What if he did that?' I felt I was going on flights of fancy with the show, and I thought that was a good sign. A person's chance of surviving #cancer should not depend on where they live. A woman diagnosed with breast cancer in a high-income country is 4x more likely to survive than a woman in parts of sub-Saharan Africa. Access to care matters. But nearly half the world can't access basic diagnostics. The treatment gaps that follow are just as wide. People are still lacking access to essential medicines, surgery, specialist care and radiotherapy. What are the solutions? 1⃣ Better capabilities to detect cancer early 2⃣ Better protections through universal health coverage 3⃣ Timely diagnosis and quality treatment: the best value we can deliver to close the cancer care gap.

Cancer can place huge financial strain on families. Many people accessing care face steep costs — and even lose income along the way. Expenses relating to accommodation, transport to clinics, and out-of-pocket payments – they all stack up. Protecting people from #cancer means protecting them from financial hardship and this can be achieved through universal health coverage, social protection and affordable access to essential services bit.ly/4wxY9VT Video

Each year, millions of young people enter labour markets across low- and middle-income countries. Yet too many rural economies are not creating enough productive opportunities to absorb them. When opportunities are limited, the effects can be far-reaching. Economic exclusion can fuel instability and increase migratory pressures, with consequences that extend beyond the communities directly affected. Evidence shows that when rural economies grow, so do people’s opportunities to build viable futures at home. Increasing investment in rural development by the equivalent of 1% of GDP can reduce out-migration by nearly one percentage point. Expanding rural employment opportunities is central to this effort. In #Cameroon, the IFAD-funded AEP-Youth programme took an innovative approach to boosting youth employment: tailored business incubators. From poultry farming to snail slime production, more than 30,000 young people benefitted from the start-up kits these incubators provided, including interest-free loans, productive grants and tailored financial products. The programme produced strong results: participants achieved 45.4% higher total gross income and 36.3% higher gross income per capita compared with non-participating households. Additionally, livestock gross income increased by 152.3% while the likelihood of selling products rose by 108.6%. But the programme generated impact far beyond young entrepreneurs themselves – supported enterprises were significantly more likely to hire labour and spent more on wages, pointing to a broader employment creation effect and showing that targeted investments can stimulate local labour demand, strengthening rural economies more broadly. With the right financing instruments, targeted support and evidence-based programme design, rural development can generate jobs, reduce pressures to migrate and contribute to more stable and inclusive growth. Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh | Innovation Meets Rural Enterprise at the State’s First Integrated Aqua Park A new chapter in rural self-reliance is taking shape in Roshni village, Khandwa, where Madhya Pradesh’s first integrated fish farming Aqua Park has been developed under the Aspirational Districts Programme. Spread across 50 acres, the Aqua Park is designed to produce 300–350 tonnes of fish every 6–8 months, with an annual revenue potential of nearly ₹3.6 crore. At the heart of this initiative are 160 tribal women entrepreneurs across 16 Self-Help Groups, with projected earnings of up to ₹2 lakh per production cycle What sets the project apart is its integrated, zero-waste ecosystem. Modern aquaculture through biofloc tanks and floating cage systems is combined with organic farming, dairy and horticulture, while nutrient-rich wastewater from fish tanks is reused to support fruit and vegetable cultivation. Through a Fish Farmer Producer Organisation (FFPO), the women are also building stronger market linkages and expanding opportunities beyond local markets. This is the Aspirational Districts Programme in action — empowering communities to shape a sustainable, self-reliant and Viksit Bharat. #AspirationalDistricts #Khandwa @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Under the leadership of Hon’ble Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta, Delhi Government has taken major decisions to preserve the civilisational legacy of Old Delhi while transforming it into a modern, vibrant heritage district. ▸ Shahjahanabad Redevelopment Corporation has been renamed as the Indraprastha Virasat Punarvikas Nigam (IVPN). ▸ Chandni Chowk will be redeveloped while preserving its heritage, architecture and cultural identity. ▸ Town Hall, tourist amenities, parking and public infrastructure will be comprehensively upgraded. ▸ Integrated redevelopment plans will be prepared for Yamuna Bazaar, the Jama Masjid area and the Old Delhi Railway Station. ▸ Historians, heritage conservation and architectural experts will be associated with the redevelopment process. The Chief Minister has directed that every development initiative must preserve Old Delhi’s heritage while strengthening trade, tourism and civic infrastructure, ensuring its timeless legacy continues to inspire future generations. #ViksitDelhi

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta launched two major initiatives in Shalimar Bagh to strengthen waste management and modernise power infrastructure. ▪️ 137 Electric Primary Waste Collection Vehicles were dedicated to the service of Delhi. These vehicles will enable efficient door-to-door waste collection across four zones, strengthening the city’s sanitation system. ▪️ The work to replace overhead power lines with AB Cables was launched across several blocks of Shalimar Bagh, ensuring a safer, more reliable and uninterrupted power supply. Guided by the vision of Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi Viksit Bharat, the Delhi Government is steadily expanding modern infrastructure and citizen-centric public services across the Capital. #ViksitDelhi

In this interview with @TheFederal_News, ICRIER's Prof. Ashok Gulati (@agulati115) makes the case that India's rice-to-ethanol push treats a symptom, not the cause. He argues that distorted incentives such as free power for irrigation, MSP bonuses over and above procurement is what created India's rice surplus in the first place, and diverting that surplus to ethanol doesn't fix the underlying policy problem. Among his recommendations: shift from crop-specific price support to direct income support, cap excessive state procurement, and locate ethanol feedstock cultivation in naturally water-abundant regions like eastern UP and north Bihar rather than water-stressed Punjab and Haryana. 🔗 Full interview: youtube.com/watch?v=UB6mET5m… #AgriculturePolicy #Ethanol #RicePolicy #ICRIER

The Pacific Island Countries collectively command Exclusive Economic Zones totalling approximately 30 million square kilometres. Undersea cables threading through their waters carry an estimated 95 per cent of international internet and financial data traffic. India has largely treated the Pacific as an afterthought. A new paper by Kripa Anand of the National Maritime Foundation argues that can no longer continue — and that Papua New Guinea, the largest Pacific Island State by territory, population, and resource endowment, offers India precisely the geopolitical anchor it needs. India has reach without Pacific presence. PNG has presence without adequate capability. The logic of partnership writes itself. Valerii Zaluzhnyi (@ZaluzhnyiUA) We are increasingly seeing assessments by analysts, including European and now American ones, that Russia has lost the war. And the end of the war is near. The reason for this is the direct interpretation of the events by the Ukrainian and European information space, which is full of mentions of successes on the battlefield and strikes on Russian logistics and critical infrastructure. The media focuses on tactical achievements, and this is natural. More details about whether there are really prerequisites to expect an imminent end of the war, whether there can be winners in it, and why NATO's current approaches have no prospects – in the article telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2… — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ZaluzhnyiUA/status/2074735920020918368#m

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

Islamabad: 9 July 2026. H.E. Dr. Gordan Grlić Radman, Minister for Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House in Islamabad, today. Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar and Foreign Secretary Amb. Amna Baloch were also present. During the warm and cordial meeting, the Prime Minister welcomed the Croatian Foreign Minister and his delegation to Pakistan. He stated that Pakistan enjoyed friendly relations with Croatia, marked by cordiality, mutual respect and shared interest. He expressed Pakistan’s desire to further strengthen bilateral cooperation, particularly through enhanced trade and investment, information technology, connectivity, agriculture, tourism and skilled manpower. While conveying his warm regards and good wishes to President Zoran Milanovic and Prime Minister Andrej Plenkovic, the Prime Minister extended a cordial invitation to both leaders to undertake official visits to Pakistan, at their kind convenience. The Croatian Foreign Minister thanked the Prime Minister for the warm welcome and said that he was honored to visit Islamabad and congratulated Pakistan and its leadership, on playing a prominent role in regional peace efforts. He also expressed his Government’s desire to enhance Pakistan-Croatia ties in all areas of mutual interest. Video

ICRIER convened an Expert Consultation on "Streamlining the Indian Spices Market: Issues and Way Forward" on 8 July 2026, bringing together policymakers, scientists, nutritionists, and industry leaders to deliberate on how food safety standards can be uniformly implemented across India's spices supply chain. Key takeaways: 🔸 India accounts for over 40% of global spice production and produces around 75 spice varieties, yet FSSAI has vertical standards for only 45, and Codex Alimentarius for just 14. 🔸 Spices are India's third-largest agricultural export, but 60-80% of the domestic market remains informal, with wide variation in quality and no standard database on domestic food safety rejections. 🔸 Lack of uniformity in testing procedures across spice testing laboratories of multiple agencies is adding an estimated INR 25,000-30,000 in compliance costs per sample. 🔸 Panelists agreed that most regulatory gaps stem from inconsistent enforcement and a lack of reliable data, not the design of standards themselves. 🔸 Recommendations include a single nodal agency to regulate the spice supply chain from farm to retail, and FSSAI leading international standard-setting as host secretariat for the Codex Committee on Spices and Culinary Herbs. The event marked the release of ICRIER's report "Streamlining the Indian Spices Market: Issues and Way Forward" by Dr Ramesh Chand, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER and Former Member, NITI Aayog, and Dr Raka Saxena, Programme Director – Agriculture Policy, NITI Aayog. 📄 Full report: icrier.org/publications/stre… #ICRIER #SpicesPolicy #FoodSafety #FSSAI #AgriPolicy #India

A must-read article from @abcnews highlights some of the major issues with any potential return to war for the United States. Not only is the blockade built on a fundamentally flawed premise that economic constriction would bring Iran to its knees in an existential war, but the blockade failed to meaningfully impact the single biggest factor in the “$500M/day” in losses that Washington claimed: Oil. Before the war, Iran was selling its sanctioned oil at a discount for about $53 a barrel, according to Obsidian Risk Advisors sanctions specialist Brett Erickson. But the war created scarcity conditions and the price of oil shot up. "In May, yes, we have a blockade imposed, but Iran still had so much oil outside the blockade line that they were able to sell it at $117 per barrel," Mr Erickson said. "So the price of the oil had more than doubled and Iran was able to really over achieve their revenues throughout the first half of the year by about 30 per cent beyond what they had projected." The Iranian budgetary year begins in March but using that rate of sale for a calendar year, Mr Erickson said Tehran "projected that they would make about $35.5 billion this year in their oil revenues". "In a six-month time period from January to July 1, you're looking at $17.75 billion," he said. The Archaeological Survey of India is honoured to undertake the conservation of Prambanan Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, under the India–Indonesia Collaborative Conservation initiative jointly launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and President of Indonesia, Prabowo Subianto. This landmark collaboration is a testament to the enduring civilisational ties between India and Indonesia, reflecting a shared commitment to preserving our rich cultural heritage and passing it on to future generations. Dating back to the 10th century CE, Prambanan Temple is Indonesia's largest Hindu temple complex dedicated to Shiva. The sprawling complex consists of 240 temples, with three magnificent central shrines devoted to Shiva, Vishnu, and Brahma. These are accompanied by three temples dedicated to their respective vahanas (divine mounts), while beautifully carved reliefs narrating the story of the Ramayana adorn the temple walls.

خشونت علیه هزاره‌های کویته از اواخر دهه‌ی ۱۹۹۰ وارد مرحله‌ای تازه شد. اگر تا پیش از آن، تبلیغات فرقه‌ای و تهدیدهای پراکنده علیه شیعیان وجود داشت، از سال ۱۹۹۹ الگوی حملات به ترورهای هدفمند و سپس به کشتارهای جمعی تغییر یافت. پژوهشگران این روند را به سه مرحله تقسیم می‌کنند: نخست، تبلیغات و نفرت‌پراکنی فرقه‌ای؛ دوم، ترور شخصیت‌های برجسته‌ی هزاره؛ و سوم، حملات گسترده با هدف کشتار جمعی غیرنظامیان. نقطه عطف این دوره، ترور سردار نثارعلی هزاره، وزیر آموزش ایالت بلوچستان، در ۵ اکتبر ۱۹۹۹ بود. افراد مسلح او را هنگام خروج از ساختمان دبیرخانه ایالت در کویته هدف قرار دادند. راننده و محافظ او کشته شدند و خود او نیز به‌شدت زخمی شد. این حمله آغاز موجی از ترورهای هدفمند علیه جامعه‌ی هزاره بود. در فاصله سال‌های ۱۹۹۹ تا ۲۰۰۳ دست‌کم ۱۷ نفر از شخصیت‌های برجسته‌ی هزاره، از جمله داکتران، انجنیران، وکلا، بازرگانان، کارمندان دولت و دانشجویان، در حملات مسلحانه کشته شدند. در بیشتر این پرونده‌ها، عاملان هرگز محاکمه نشدند. سال ۲۰۰۳ نقطه تغییر در الگوی خشونت بود. در ۸ جون، افراد مسلح موتر حامل دانشجویان پولیس هزاره را در مسیر آکادمی پولیس هدف قرار دادند. در این حمله ۱۲ پولیس کشته و نُه نفر زخمی شدند. کم‌تر از یک ماه بعد، در ۴ جولای، سه مهاجم مسلح وارد امام‌باره‌ای در سرک میچنگی (Mechangi Road) شدند و نمازگزاران را به گلوله بستند. در این حمله دست‌کم ۴۷ تا ۵۳ نفر کشته و ده‌ها نفر دیگر زخمی شدند. گروه لشکر جهنگوی مسئولیت این حمله را بر عهده گرفت. این رویداد، نخستین کشتار جمعی گسترده‌ی هزاره‌ها در کویته به شمار می‌رود. در ۲۴ مارچ ۲۰۰۴، هم‌زمان با مراسم عاشورا در نزدیکی لیاقت‌بازار کویته، افراد مسلح از چند نقطه به دسته‌ی عزاداران تیراندازی کردند و نارنجک پرتاب کردند. دست‌کم ۳۶ نفر کشته و ده‌ها نفر زخمی شدند. این حمله نشان داد که عاملان دیگر تنها افراد مشخص را هدف قرار نمی‌دهند، بلکه تجمع‌های مذهبی و غیرنظامیان نیز به اهداف اصلی آنان تبدیل شده‌اند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/256966

As the hometown of "Dongchang Gourd Carving," a nationally recognized intangible cultural heritage, Liaocheng accounts for 75% of China's gourd market. A Brazilian couple is now fighting to avoid prison after homeschooling their two daughters. A court sentenced Audato and Ieda Denardi to 50 days behind bars, ruling they committed "intellectual neglect" by teaching their children outside a state-approved curriculum. According to their legal team, the judge cited the family's failure to include lessons on gender, sex education, "tolerance and diversity," and even pointed to the girls' preference for religious and classical music over popular genres. The parents say they began homeschooling during the COVID-19 pandemic after losing confidence in their daughters' schools. They remain free while appealing what their attorneys believe is the first criminal prosecution of its kind in Brazil.

Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

There seems to be a conception that if US air defense systems are exhausted then the US has to capitulate. This is fundamentally incorrect. The only way to get any adversary to capitulate is to destroy their will to fight. Air defense systems are actually a de-escalation measure, because they limit damage to allies that would otherwise become a call for escalation. In any escalating scenario, the US has an unmatched advantage. The US can essentially instantly delete any target it wants with zero risk to its own personnel in about 20 different ways, from individual vehicles up to entire cities. The US's adversaries should pray that the US never runs out of air defense, so they can keep lobbing their puny and obviously ineffective missiles at their neighbors in a spate of infantile rage, because if they were to land enough hits, the US would switch from nation building to nation destroying. This last occurred in 1941 and was a rough time for all involved. The only difference is that now the US is far richer and far more advanced relative to the tiny club of insane despots who treat their own subjects (citizens would be too strong a word for people who have no civic rights) with even more contempt than they do the US, whose wealth and power drives them mad with envy. It has become extremely clear that 99.9% of the world is thrilled to run some form of peaceful free trade capitalism and get super rich within the more-than-effective deterrence envelope of 2026 norms around rules of engagement. The 0.1% evidently cannot be deterred by sub-meter precision blowing up their stuff or the surgical deletion of their political colleagues, so one might sensibly ask: What will destroy their will to fight or their ability to continue to wreck it all for everyone else? पिछले सप्ताह हुई UGC-NET परीक्षा को लेकर सामने आए गंभीर आरोप बेहद चौंकाने वाले हैं। NEET पेपर लीक के कुछ ही हफ्तों बाद अब खबरें आ रही हैं कि - - UGC-NET परीक्षा से ठीक पहले 100 पन्नों की एक PDF प्रसारित हुई। - यह PDF उस question paper setting की है, जो सिर्फ़ NTA के पास उपलब्ध होती है। - PDF के लगभग 90 सवाल Sociology के असली प्रश्नपत्र से मेल खाते हैं। - वही प्रश्नपत्र ₹2.25 लाख में बिहार, उत्तर प्रदेश, हरियाणा, दिल्ली और राजस्थान में बेचा जा रहा था। - इसी नेटवर्क ने CSIR-NET, HTET और ADA जैसी आगामी परीक्षाओं के प्रश्नपत्र उपलब्ध कराने का भी दावा किया। NEET और NET में बार-बार सामने आए घोटालों के बाद भी मोदी सरकार आंखें मूंदकर सो रही है, क्योंकि लाखों छात्रों की रात-रात जागकर की गई सालों की मेहनत उनके लिए कोई मायने नहीं रखती। सारा देश जानता है कि प्रधानमंत्री और शिक्षा मंत्री से किसी भी तरह की जवाबदेही या कार्रवाई की उम्मीद बेकार है - न जांच होगी, न छात्रों को न्याय मिलेगा। बदलाव का एकमात्र औज़ार हमारी सम्मिलित आवाज़ है - देश भर के छात्रों की गूंज, जो भारत में शिक्षा revolution लाकर रहेगी।

The U.S. Department of Energy instructed AI data centers to stop using electricity from the main power grid. As temperatures exceeded 100 degrees Fahrenheit across much of the eastern United States Energy Secretary Chris Wright ordered data centers and other major electricity consumers on the PJM grid to switch to backup generators. The purpose was to conserve power so that homes could continue running air conditioners during one of the hottest periods of the year. The PJM grid serves 13 states and includes northern Virginia which hosts the largest cluster of data centers in the world. These centers support AI systems cloud computing streaming services and much of the internet but they require massive amounts of electricity. Officials explained that backup generators would ease strain on the grid and help avoid blackouts while millions of air conditioners operated at peak levels. This action illustrates how the rapid growth of AI infrastructure is starting to compete with regular household electricity needs during extreme heat waves. There are drawbacks to the solution. Most backup generators burn diesel or natural gas which creates more local air pollution than power from large plants. The region also has limited battery storage compared to states like California and Texas making it challenging to handle demand surges with cleaner sources. As AI data centers expand across the country experts predict that extreme heat events will increasingly challenge the ability of the power grid to meet both technological and everyday needs.

Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, addressed the National Workshop on Strengthening Tribal Research Institutes, organised by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in Bhubaneswar. The workshop focused on strengthening research, technology, governance, institutional capacity and partnerships to build Tribal Research Institutes into stronger knowledge and policy institutions. Dr. Balasubramaniam called for Tribal Research Institutes to broaden their research agenda to better understand the social, political, economic and cultural transitions shaping tribal communities. He emphasised that research must move beyond data to listening by respecting tribal belief systems, lived experiences and traditional wisdom, and that TRIs should serve as anthropological knowledge repositories, policy think tanks and advocates for tribal voices, while humanising data through ground truthing and community perspectives. Recognising indigenous knowledge as a national resource, he called for its documentation, preservation and recognition, and methodologies to account for its contribution to India’s Gross Domestic Knowledge Product. As AI reshapes the future, preserving indigenous knowledge and strengthening tribal-led research become even more critical. The workshop also launched TribeX, a digital learning platform for tribal arts, culture, languages, traditional knowledge and skill development. #TribalDevelopment #IndigenousKnowledge @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @drrbalu

Never-before-seen footage of the private island of convicted child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein gives a detailed tour of the hideaway to which a number of survivors allege they were trafficked and exploited. Ion Nicola, a Romanian artist who told Storyful he worked for Epstein from 2010 to 2019 – carrying out work in a number of buildings – filmed this footage as he drove around the island of Little Saint James. The video starts with a view of one of the island’s bays as Nicola drives along a single-track road in a golf cart. His drive reveals a huge sun dial, and a gorilla statue – one of a number of large stone statues on the island. The footage shows manicured lawns, plants, and various paths; a view of a pier and beach shows several boats present. A number of shaded areas are seen along the beach, with two further human-like statues marking one of them. Nicola then drives up a hill and, as the camera turns, a pool house is seen by the cliff edge. Nicola gets out of the vehicle at the main residence on the island, which has a large pool area. As he walks to the terrace of the building, a large “E” is seen below. Nicola told Storyful he was the artist responsible for the interior artwork in the island’s mosque-like Five Palms building. Alexandra de Hoop Scheffer (@AdeHoopScheffer) The transition from a US- to a Europe-led security order is no longer theoretical. It is underway. The Trump administration's announced reduction in American military capabilities in Europe and the undertaking of a broader force review marks the first step in a structural burden-shift that no successor is likely to reverse. Whether that shift opens a window of opportunity or of vulnerability depends on the speed and sustainability of Europe’s response, and on Washington’s view of a stronger European industrial base as an asset instead of a competitive threat. European NATO members and Canada raised defense spending by 20% in real terms in 2025, bringing their combined total to $574 billion. Yet the central paradox is stark: Europe is beginning to spend for wartime while still procuring and planning for peacetime. Closing that gap is the defining defense policy challenge of this decade, and it requires three urgent measures. 1️⃣ First, align procurement with threat reality and use Ukrainian expertise. The ReArm Europe plan is a start, but ambition must be matched by ruthless industrial pragmatism. Europe faces a real dilemma: rebuilding its defense-industrial base for long-term autonomy while urgently closing immediate capability gaps. These goals are not mutually exclusive, but they require balancing. Ukraine, now a co-architect of European security, is central to this, as European defense firms move from supplying Kyiv to co-developing combat-proven technology. 2️⃣ Second, include the private sector. Defense and security policy in Europe has long been the preserve of governments and militaries. That model is obsolete in an era when the most consequential capabilities—autonomous systems, AI-enabled intelligence, cybersecurity, and satellite communications—are being built in commercial labs. Policymakers must treat technology companies not as contractors but as strategic partners that must be in discussions to set industrial priorities. 3️⃣ Third, reframe the transatlantic bargain as strategic complementarity. Washington must encourage Europe to build its own industrial base, not treat it as a competitive threat. Strategic complementarity—not dependency—is the model that works for both sides. Complementarity is particularly apparent in defense tech. The U.S. leads in AI-enabled systems, space-based intelligence, and autonomous platforms; Europe's strengths lie in advanced manufacturing, sovereign cyber capabilities, laser technology, and a rapidly maturing dual-use deep tech ecosystem. 🚨 The NATO summit in Ankara should be the moment allies stop relitigating the terms of the alliance and formalize a new framework of strategic complementarity through agreed capability targets, a transatlantic defense innovation compact, and a shared framework for managing the transition without breaking the alliance. National water availability data at your fingertips! 💧🎉 The National Water Availability Assessment Data Companion provides regularly updated, model-based estimates of water availability and use on a national scale. Nearly 27 million Americans, or 8% of the U.S. population, live in areas where water demand consistently approaches or exceeds naturally available water supply. Until recently, accessing comprehensive water availability information with national coverage required stitching together disparate datasets across multiple agencies, regions, and complicated websites. The Data Companion eliminates these barriers by: 💧 Providing consistent information about water availability and use across approximately 80,000 watersheds nationwide from 2000 to 2020 💧 Enabling data access through various user-friendly means, including a subset and download tool, a data file directory, an API, and a new interactive map 💧 Continually adding new and updated data to reflect the latest USGS water models and science Check out the interactive map now: water.usgs.gov/nwaa-data/ 📷 1: View of soil moisture data for January 2020 across the lower 48 United States from the Data Companion web mapper.

Africa’s future will be shaped in its rural economies and areas. Today at @IFAD, I was pleased to co-host with Italy the event “Advancing the Italian Mattei Plan: Scaling Joint Investments in Agriculture and Food Systems.” The #MatteiPlan reflects an important shift in international cooperation with Africa: moving from traditional donor-recipient models towards equal-to-equal partnership, shared ownership, co-investment and mutual benefit. The third annual progress report to the Italian Parliament shows how this approach is moving from vision to implementation across priority areas including agriculture, water, energy, infrastructure, education and health, with IFAD recognized among the international partners supporting this agenda. This direction is closely aligned with IFAD’s mandate. We invest with governments and rural communities to strengthen smallholder agriculture, build resilient value chains, expand access to finance and markets, and create opportunities where they are needed most. Italy and IFAD’s collaboration under the Mattei Plan is now moving from alignment to implementation: Côte d’Ivoire is partnering with Italy and IFAD to advance a major milestone through the Agro-Industrial Pole Project in the North-East. Italy’s €100 million co-financing will complement IFAD’s US$75 million investment to support climate-adaptive agriculture, strengthen value chains and improve food and nutrition security for more than 35,000 rural families, around 220,000 people. The Government of Senegal is working with Italy, IFAD, @TheOPECFund and @EIB on a US$265 million co-investment programme to support food sovereignty and reach more than one million people. With Angola, we are exploring further collaboration in the coffee value chain, drawing on Italian expertise and private sector engagement. These examples show how public investment, technical expertise and private sector partnerships can come together to deliver lasting impact at the first mile of food systems. With more than 60 per cent of IFAD’s portfolio in Africa, and with our country presence, IFAD is a strong partner of the Mattei Plan. As we look towards #IFAD14, with its focus on market integration, employment and resilience, this partnership offers a strong operational platform to scale joint investments with African countries. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 chaired the 7th meeting of the High-Level Committee overseeing preparations for the 9th OIC Ministerial Conference on Women, which Pakistan will host on 12–13 July 2026. The Committee conducted a detailed review of the preparations, including the conference venue, programme, delegate facilitation, protocol, security, logistics, media arrangements, and inter-ministerial coordination, to ensure the smooth and successful conduct of the Conference. Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister emphasized the importance of flawless execution during the final stage of preparations and instructed all concerned ministries and agencies to remain fully engaged, strengthen coordination, and ensure that outstanding tasks are completed within the stipulated timelines. The meeting was attended by SAPM Tariq Bajwa, Parliamentary Secretary for Human Rights Ms. Saba Sadiq, the Federal Secretaries of Human Rights and the Cabinet Division, and senior officials of the relevant ministries.

Statement from Trinamool Congress All funds held in the party’s bank accounts have been fully and transparently disclosed. The party has duly reported all donation transactions to the Election Commission of India (ECI) and the Income Tax Department. These disclosures are published annually on the ECI’s website and are available in the public domain. The details relating to electoral bonds are already available with the Government of India, as the bonds were issued by the State Bank of India (SBI) and subsequently submitted to the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India. The Enforcement Directorate’s decision to freeze the party’s bank accounts is a politically motivated act. We strongly condemn this arbitrary and illegal action. پیکر شاپور زدران، ستاره‌ی پیشین تیم ملی کریکت افغانستان، پس از چاشت ام‌روز (چهارشنبه، ۱۷ سرطان) از هند به کابل منتقل شد. شاپور زدران، یکی از چهره‌های برجسته و تأثیرگذار کریکت افغانستان، شام سه‌شنبه پس از چندین ماه مبارزه با بیماری، در یکی از شفاخانه‌های شهر دهلی‌نو هند چشم از جهان فرو بست. او از ماه جنوری سال روان برای درمان بیماری نادر سیستم ایمنی بدن (HLH) در هند بستری بود، اما تلاش پزشکان برای نجات جانش نتیجه نداد. منبع‌های نزدیک به خانواده‌ی زدران گفته‌اند که پیکر این ورزش‌کار پیشین پس از کابل، برای برگزاری مراسم تشییع و خاک‌سپاری به زادگاهش منتقل می‌شود. انتظار می‌رود در این مراسم، عضوهای خانواده، شماری از مقام‌های حکومتی، مسئولان کریکت، ورزش‌کاران و صدها تن از هواداران او حضور داشته باشند. شاپور زدران از پیش‌گامان کریکت افغانستان به شمار می‌رفت و نقش برجسته‌ای در رشد و جهانی‌شدن این رشته ورزشی در کشور داشت. او بین سال‌های ۲۰۰۹ تا ۲۰۲۰ در ۴۴ مسابقه یک‌روزه و ۳۶ دیدار بیست‌آوره برای تیم ملی افغانستان به میدان رفت و با عمل‌کرد درخشان خود، در صعود تیم ملی به رقابت‌های معتبر جهانی، از جمله جام جهانی کریکت، سهم مهمی ایفا کرد. درگذشت شاپور زدران با موج گسترده‌ای از پیام‌های تسلیت از سوی بازی‌کنان، مسئولان کریکت افغانستان و هواداران این ورزش همراه شده‌است. بسیاری از آنان از او به‌عنوان یکی از معماران نسل طلایی کریکت افغانستان یاد کرده و خدماتش به ورزش کشور را ماندگار توصیف کرده‌اند. #خبریک Video

We also aligned our positions on upcoming international events. There are many important events ahead – both abroad and in Ukraine. We discussed in detail the energy track and preparations for winter. Everyone is interested in ending this war before winter, but regardless of how events unfold, we must be ready to protect our people and ensure Ukraine’s resilience. I am grateful for the energy support and for the fact that all previous agreements are being implemented. There are new ideas as well. We are working together on the energy security of all of Europe. The Ministry of Home Affairs' Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) has issued a public advisory warning against a sharp rise in online matrimonial frauds, where cybercriminals exploit matrimonial websites and apps by posing as wealthy professionals, NRIs, doctors, engineers or Army officers to gain victims' trust. According to the advisory, fraudsters typically build an emotional relationship over days or weeks before seeking money on various pretexts, including customs charges for expensive gifts, travel expenses, visa fees or medical emergencies. Once the payment is made, they either disappear or continue demanding additional funds using new excuses. The government has urged users to remain vigilant and verify every prospective match through video calls, family members, employment details and reverse image searches before placing their trust in someone online. People have also been advised never to transfer money to anyone known only through the internet. Victims or those who suspect cyber fraud should immediately report the incident by calling the national cybercrime helpline 1930 or filing a complaint through the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, while preserving chat records, profile links, transaction receipts and other digital evidence to assist investigators. #CyberCrime #MatrimonialFraud #CyberSecurity #DigitalSafety #ScamAlert #MarriageScam #FakeProfiles #MinistryOfHomeAffairs #CyberAwareness#IndiaToday

आम आदमी की जेब पर पड़ा असर, जून में खाने की थाली महंगी, टमाटर-प्याज और तेल ने बढ़ाया बजट का बोझ आम आदमी की जेब पर बड़ा असर देखने को मिला है. जून 2026 में घर पर बनने वाली शाकाहारी और मांसाहारी थाली की कॉस्ट पांच महीने के हाई लेवल पर पहुंच गई है. क्रिसिल इंटेलिजेंस की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक टमाटर, प्याज, आलू, खाद्य तेल और LPG की बढ़ती कीमतों ने रसोई का बजट बिगाड़ दिया है. रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, जून में एक शाकाहारी थाली की कीमत बढ़कर 28.4 रुपये हो गई, ये मई में 27.4 रुपये थी. ये महीने-दर-महीने (MoM) 4 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी है. वहीं, जून 2025 में शाकाहारी थाली की कीमत 27.1 रुपये थी, जिसके मुकाबले इस साल जून में यह 5 फीसदी अधिक रही. इसी तरह, जून में एक मांसाहारी थाली की लागत 58.2 रुपये रही, जबकि मई में यह 56.5 रुपये थी, यानी इसमें महीने-दर-महीने 3 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी हुई. पिछले साल जून में इसकी कीमत 54.8 रुपये थी, जिसके मुकाबले इस साल यह 6 फीसदी महंगी हो गई. . . रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, थाली की लागत बढ़ने की सबसे बड़ी वजह टमाटर की कीमतों में तेज उछाल रही. जून 2026 में टमाटर की औसत कीमत 42 रुपये प्रति किलोग्राम पहुंच गई. ये जून 2025 में 32 रुपये प्रति किलोग्राम थी, यानी इसमें सालाना आधार पर 31 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी हुई. Crisil के मुताबिक, फरवरी और मार्च में अत्यधिक गर्मी के कारण गर्मियों की फसल की बुवाई में देरी और उत्पादन कम रहने से टमाटर महंगा हुआ. वहीं, प्याज की कीमतों में सालाना आधार पर 2 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी दर्ज की गई. इसकी वजह अधिक कीमत वाले रबी सीजन के स्टॉक का बाजार में आना रही. रिपोर्ट में कहा गया है कि खाद्य तेल और एलपीजी सिलेंडर की कीमतों में भी सालाना आधार पर 10-10 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी हुई. इसके पीछे पश्चिम एशिया में जारी संघर्ष के कारण सप्लाई प्रभावित होना एक प्रमुख कारण बताया गया है. हालांकि, ताजा रबी फसल की आवक बढ़ने से आलू की कीमतों में 14 फीसदी की गिरावट दर्ज की गई. इससे थाली की लागत में होने वाली बढ़ोतरी को कुछ हद तक संतुलित करने में मदद मिली. महीने-दर-महीने आधार पर जून में टमाटर की कीमतों में 17 फीसदी, आलू में 5 फीसदी और प्याज में 8 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी हुई. इसके चलते अन्य खाद्य वस्तुओं में कुछ नरमी के बावजूद शाकाहारी थाली की लागत बढ़ गई. मांसाहारी थाली के महंगा होने की एक और बड़ी वजह ब्रॉयलर चिकन की कीमतों में बढ़ोतरी रही. रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, ब्रॉयलर की कीमतों में सालाना आधार पर अनुमानित 7 फीसदी की ग्रोथ हुई है. चूंकि मांसाहारी थाली की कुल लागत में ब्रॉयलर की हिस्सेदारी करीब 50 फीसदी होती है. इसलिए इसका सीधा असर थाली की कीमत पर पड़ा. Each year, millions of young people enter labour markets across low- and middle-income countries. Yet too many rural economies are not creating enough productive opportunities to absorb them. When opportunities are limited, the effects can be far-reaching. Economic exclusion can fuel instability and increase migratory pressures, with consequences that extend beyond the communities directly affected. Evidence shows that when rural economies grow, so do people’s opportunities to build viable futures at home. Increasing investment in rural development by the equivalent of 1% of GDP can reduce out-migration by nearly one percentage point. Expanding rural employment opportunities is central to this effort. In #Cameroon, the IFAD-funded AEP-Youth programme took an innovative approach to boosting youth employment: tailored business incubators. From poultry farming to snail slime production, more than 30,000 young people benefitted from the start-up kits these incubators provided, including interest-free loans, productive grants and tailored financial products. The programme produced strong results: participants achieved 45.4% higher total gross income and 36.3% higher gross income per capita compared with non-participating households. Additionally, livestock gross income increased by 152.3% while the likelihood of selling products rose by 108.6%. But the programme generated impact far beyond young entrepreneurs themselves – supported enterprises were significantly more likely to hire labour and spent more on wages, pointing to a broader employment creation effect and showing that targeted investments can stimulate local labour demand, strengthening rural economies more broadly. With the right financing instruments, targeted support and evidence-based programme design, rural development can generate jobs, reduce pressures to migrate and contribute to more stable and inclusive growth. WHO Regional Director for the Eastern Mediterranean Hanan Balkhy says she held key discussions with Afghan officials in Kabul and Kandahar during the Polio Oversight Board mission to Afghanistan on efforts to eradicate polio and expand health services. In a post on X, Balkhy said the meetings emphasized the need to vaccinate every child against wild poliovirus, strengthen disease surveillance, and reinforce routine immunization. She added that strengthening Afghanistan's health system and expanding access to essential healthcare, particularly in remote areas, require sustained international donor support. #TOLOnews_English

The newly appointed Deputy Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for Afghanistan, Bruno Lemarquis, has met with Herat Governor Mawlana Islam Jar during his visit to the province to discuss UN programs, economic cooperation, counter-narcotics efforts, and the situation of returning migrants. According to the Herat governor's office, Lemarquis praised the progress made in Herat in combating narcotics, promoting economic development, and managing the large influx of migrants. He said the United Nations would continue implementing its programs in coordination with the Islamic Emirate to better address the needs of the Afghan people. Governor Islam Jar highlighted the local administration's efforts to combat corruption and narcotics, advance major economic projects, and improve public services, reaffirming Herat's commitment to continued cooperation with the United Nations. #TOLOnews_English

Signed into law the Sovereign Wealth Fund Bill, 2026, establishing a national investment vehicle aimed at preserving wealth generated from Kenya's natural resources and strategic investments for future generations. The new law is a historic milestone that will ensure the country's prosperity endures beyond the current generation. With this consequential law, Kenya has put in place watertight mechanisms that will ensure the resources attained from strategic assets and natural resources endure for generations. The Sovereign Wealth Fund serves as a guarantee that revenues from petroleum and other valuable mineral resources are not entirely consumed by the present generation but are invested to benefit our children and the children of our children. The legislation establishes three key windows under the fund: The Stabilisation Fund will cushion the economy against external shocks, the Strategic Investment Window will finance national development projects and create jobs, while the Future Generations pillar - Urithi Fund - will invest a portion of petroleum and mineral revenues for future citizens. Under the law, 30 per cent of revenues from petroleum and mineral resources will be channelled into the Urithi Fund, with the remainder supporting economic stability and strategic investments. The Sovereign Wealth Fund becomes the second major financial institution created under the Government's economic transformation agenda after the establishment of the National Infrastructure Fund in March 2026. This fund is designed to mobilise private capital for development projects.

اسلام آباد : 8 جولائی، 2026 وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت گلگت بلتستان کے لئے 100 میگا واٹ شمسی توانائی منصوبے پر جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ماحول دوست صاف، سستی اور پائیدار توانائی کے فروغ کے لیے شمسی توانائی کا فروغ قومی توانائی کا اہم جزو ہے. 100 میگاواٹ سولر منصوبہ وفاقی حکومت کی جانب سے گلگت بلتستان کے عوام کے لیے ایک تحفہ ہے. پاور ڈویژن منصوبے کی تنصیب اور بروقت تکمیل کے حوالے سے اپنی ذمے داری پوری کرے. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ سولر منصوبے کیلئے خریداری کے عمل میں مکمل شفافیت یقینی بنائی جائے. تمام ادائیگیاں تیسرے فریق کی توثیق (Third-Party Validation) کے بعد کی جائیں. اجلاس کو گلگت بلتستان شمسی توانائی منصوبے پر پیشرفت کے حوالے سے بریفنگ بھی دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ منصوبے کے تحت 499 سرکاری عمارتوں کی چھتوں پر بیٹری اسٹوریج سمیت 18 میگاواٹ سولر سسٹم دسمبر 2026 تک نصب کر دیا جائے گا. 82 میگاواٹ یوٹیلٹی اسکیل سولر منصوبے کا پی سی ون منظوری کے لیے ایکنک (ECNEC) کو بھجوا دیا گیا.82 میگاواٹ سولر منصوبے سے تقریباً 13 لاکھ افراد مستفید ہوں گے. منصوبے کی تکمیل سے گلگت بلتستان میں سروس کا معیار بہتر ہو گا اور لوڈ شیڈنگ کے خاتمے میں مدد ملے گی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر برائے پاور ڈویژن سردار اویس لغاری، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ و ریلوے بلال اظہر کیانی اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی۔ Video
